# MBDC

> > MBDC is the creator of the Cradle to Cradle Design Framework, pioneering circular economy principles and material health assessment for sustainable product innovation.

Founded by William McDonough, MBDC develops and implements the Cradle to Cradle Certified Products Program, working with companies like SunPower, Steelcase, and The Home Depot to transform product design through rigorous material health and circular economy assessments.

## Key Topics

- Cradle to Cradle Design Framework
- Cradle to Cradle Certified Products Program
- William McDonough
- Material Health Assessment
- Circular Economy
- Product Certification
- Sustainable Product Design
- McDonough Innovation
- Chemical Safety & Toxnot
- Carbon Positive Cities
- Supply Chain Sustainability
- Upcycling vs Recycling
- Regrettable Substitution
- Jay Bolus
